# Identification

State the product name, the intended use, and the supplier contact.

# Hazards

Classify the hazards under the regulation. Give the hazard
statements and the precautionary statements.

# Composition

List the hazardous ingredients and their concentration ranges.

# First aid measures

State the first aid for each route of exposure: inhalation, skin,
eye, and ingestion.

# Firefighting measures

State the extinguishing media and the fire hazards.

# Accidental release

State the containment and clean-up procedures.

# Handling and storage

State the safe handling precautions and the storage conditions.

# Exposure controls

Give the exposure limits and the personal protection required.

# Physical and chemical properties

Give the appearance, flash point, and solubility.

# Stability and reactivity

State the conditions to avoid and the incompatible materials.

# Toxicological information

Summarise the acute and chronic effects.

# Ecological information

Summarise the ecotoxicity and persistence.

# Disposal considerations

State the disposal route.

# Transport information

Give the UN number and the transport hazard class.

# Regulatory information

State the regulatory status.

# Other information

State the revision date and the source of the data.
